before: V=4 followed by sigma=sqrt(9) passed because the root branch ignored the given variance.
A numeric token in an unexecuted BEGIN-VERIFY comment/assertion was treated as proof of sigma. A coincident variance elsewhere in the chapter also replaced missing local evidence.
The equality chain V=4=9 was accepted by taking its last value; even distinct integers beyond floating precision were not compared exactly.
after: An explicit sigma root is confronted with the nearest local variance whenever one is supplied.
Oracle text and unrelated matching numbers grant no evidence. Missing local variance/evidence remains a CERTIFICATION_BLOCKER, without claiming the number is mathematically false.

Numeric links joined by equality are compared as exact Fractions. Inconsistent chains produce EXACT_EQUALITY_MISMATCH P0 and cannot supply downstream evidence. Approximation separates equality chains.

scientific_argument: sqrt(9)=3 differs from sqrt(4)=2, so sigma=sqrt(9) contradicts V=4.

All terms connected by equality must have the same value; two distinct rational values prove a contradiction even if another intervening term is unreadable. Exact Fraction comparison distinguishes9007199254740992 and9007199254740993.
Textual occurrence of an assertion does not prove execution or semantic association with the claimed statistic. A matching value elsewhere provides no object/source binding.

legacy_test_change.preserved_inputs: The same3946-without-support and printed sqrt(15552000) assertion fixtures are retained.
legacy_test_change.changed_expectation: Both now require the explicit SIGMA_WITHOUT_ORACLE certification blocker. The latter no longer treats an unexecuted source assertion as a receipt; the former no longer calls an unsupported number a demonstrated product error.
legacy_test_change.no_gate_weakening: The CLI still fails on any certification blocker. All existing numeric mismatch tests continue to demand product P0. No skip or xfail added.

tests.intermediate_reason: The two historical expectations still conflated missing evidence with product falsehood or unexecuted oracle text with validation.
tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_variance_proof_obligations.py tests/test_variance_unparsed_claims.py tests/test_variance_sigma_consistency.py tests/test_latex_arith_exact_contract.py -k 'not co_048 and not math_corpus and not covers_every_math' --junitxml=/tmp/variance-proof-obligations-targeted.xml
tests.scope: Controlled fixtures only; the four real-corpus tests were not run.

scope_limits: The lexical audit checks the declared consistency class; it does not independently establish every variance from its original probability model.
Unsupported claims from QA015 remain explicit blockers, including correct irrational radicals outside the Fraction API.
No complete current-corpus zero-defect claim is supported by these fixture tests.
No global QCM evidence, historical receipt or human packet has been regenerated.
Les deux nouveaux défauts reproduits par /root gardent le consommateur ouvert ; aucune clôture globale avant correction et revue fraîche.

independent_counterreview.read_extent: Diff intégral, fonctions de parsing et de contrôle touchées, tests et manifest lus. Tests conservés avec mêmes inputs ; tout désaccord exact démontré reste P0, absence de preuve bloque sans faux défaut.

V(X)=4 et sigma(X)=2{,}0000000001 avec signe égal : aucune finding, car les décimales sont traitées comme arrondis et une tolérance flottante est appliquée.
